services.name: Half Day Deep Sea Fishing
services.desc: Serious fishing on a tight schedule: a private 4-5 hour deep sea charter with the best fishing often just 3-5 miles out.

services.name: 3/4 Day Deep Sea Fishing
services.desc: Our most popular trip: a private 6-7 hour deep sea charter with time to cover more water and fish multiple techniques.

services.name: Full Day Deep Sea Fishing
services.desc: A private 8-9 hour deep sea charter that lets us follow the bite through the day, and summer's best trip for mahi.

services.name: Extended Full Day
services.desc: Our longest deep sea trip: 10-11 hours of tournament-pace fishing for anglers looking to put up numbers and fill the box.

services.name: Swordfishing Charter
services.desc: A specialized 10-11 hour daytime hunt for broadbill swordfish with electric reels, best for anglers ready to commit a full day to one species.

services.name: Half Day Inshore Fishing
services.desc: Our most popular inshore trip: a private 4-hour light-tackle charter on Biscayne Bay with short runs and plenty of rod-in-hand action.

services.name: Evening & Night Tarpon/Snook Fishing
services.desc: A private 4-hour evening hunt for tarpon and snook in the inlets and passes. Leave before sunset and fish under the city lights.

services.name: Full Day Inshore Fishing
services.desc: Private 8-hour light-tackle charter exploring Biscayne Bay with time for an optional bayfront lunch stop.

quotes.text: Had an awesome time on this fishing charter! Ryan and Chris were great, the boat was in excellent shape, and they knew exactly where to find the fish. We had an incredible day and ended up catching some beautiful Mahi. The whole experience was professional, fun, and well worth it. Would definitely recommend this charter to anyone looking for a great day on the water!

Amazing first time deep sea fishing experience! Our guides Kristjan and Ryan were phenomenal,patient, knowledgeable, and taught us so much along the way. They made us feel comfortable and confident the whole trip, even as complete beginners. We caught fish, had a blast, and would absolutely do it again. Highly recommend asking for Kristjan and if you book a charter!

What a great crew! I fish all the time different places. These guys are the best! They are the best in Miami. They know how to fish. If you’re looking to fish I wouldn’t look anywhere else. They put me on fish every time! Lifelong place for me and my family!!!
As one of the highest-rated charter operations in Miami, we have earned hundreds of five-star reviews from real guests across Google and TripAdvisor. Here is what some of them have to say.
This was an awesome experience - beautiful boat, Chris and Ryan were great. Caught more than we knew what to do with! Would recommend to anyone wanting to go out for a fishing trip
Great experience with Kris and Brian. Everything ran on time, we had a lot of fun and most importantly caught a bunch of fish. Will re book
